classification_limits: Input/output contract determines the type; LSTM or Transformer and an NxDx5 tensor do not imply target autoregression or sequence-to-sequence.
No explicit target lags does not establish independence or exogeneity of OHLCV relative to target volatility.
High residual autocorrelation requires a documented reconsideration, not automatic type3 reclassification.
Adding explicit volatility lags requires a registered contract/route review before execution.
architecture_orientation_limits: Typical MLP/LSTM/GRU/shallow-CNN families are orientation, not a final selected trio.
No independent nonlinear MLP or simple CNN1D is accredited in the current bounded five-text corpus.
The source TCN winner is wide and six-level; not automatically a shallow-CNN baseline.
Encoder attention is not a typical family listed in guide6.4, but the list does not prohibit it; its simplicity and grey-source sufficiency remain unresolved.
